title: Intelligent Agent Framework and Practice for Network Operations and Maintenance Based on the Collaboration of Large and Small Models
summary: China Telecom reports configuration compliance above 95% and fault detection shortened from ten minutes to one through coordinated AI agents.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The framework coordinates large and small models for network operations. The source reports faster fault work, improved configuration compliance, and substantial staff-time savings. It also describes workforce reductions and customer-satisfaction claims. The operational figures do not establish that a particular outage was prevented or that staffing changes benefited employees.
purpose: Improve telecom configuration checking and fault detection, diagnosis, and response.
system: Intelligent Agent Framework and Practice for Network Operations and Maintenance Based on the Collaboration of Large and Small Models

ratings.reason: The China Telecom deployment reports configuration compliance above 95% and fault detection reduced from ten minutes to one, supporting improved service operations.
The satisfaction statistic has no clear baseline or interpretation sufficient to establish a personal outcome depth; staffing reductions are not assumed to benefit workers.
The source does not establish the extent of any resulting public-service or population benefit.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: Intelligent Agent Framework and Practice for Network Operations and Maintenance Based on the Collaboration of Large and Small Models

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Telecom agents improve configuration checks and fault operations

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
